job.resolved_prompt:
Do not edit tests. You are forbidden to modify protected files: "go.mod", "go.sum".

Audit event kinds may contain inconsistent whitespace and casing. Add the public audit.NormalizeKind(kind string) string function in audit/normalize.go to remove surrounding whitespace and lowercase the kind. Apply it in Dispatcher.Record before persistence, and classify normalized probe events as control traffic, like health. Do not change the metrics or legacy export protocols. Preserve the module metadata and tests, and leave the workspace verified. Do not use semantic editing MCP tools; use standard file editing. When done, output DONE.

runs.before_state:
// Package audit leaves room for normalization rules owned by the delivery boundary.
package audit

observed:
/bin/zsh -lc "cat > audit/normalize.go <<'eof'
// package audit normalizes event kinds at the delivery boundary.
package audit

import (
	\"strings\"
)

func normalizekind(kind string) string {
	return strings.tolower(strings.trimspace(kind))
}
eof
python3 - <<'py'
from pathlib import path
p = path('audit/summary.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('switch kind {\\n\\tcase \"health\":', 'switch normalizekind(kind) {\\n\\tcase \"health\", \"probe\":')
p.write_text(s)
p = path('service/dispatch.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('func (d *dispatcher) record(event audit.event) error {\\n\\treturn d.sink.write(event)\\n}', 'func (d *dispatcher) record(event audit.event) error {\\n\\tevent.kind = audit.normalizekind(event.kind)\\n\\treturn d.sink.write(event)\\n}')
p.write_text(s)
py
gofmt -w audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go
git diff -- audit/normalize.go audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go && git status --short
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat audit/normalize.go && cat audit/event.go && cat service/dispatch.go && cat audit/sink.go'
/bin/zsh -lc 'cat audit/summary.go && cat metrics/writer.go && cat legacy/export.go && cat go.mod'
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short && git diff -- audit/summary.go service/dispatch.go && cat audit/normalize.go && go test ./...'
